CustomField.label: Action Type
CustomField.description: What kind of action this is. A screen flow opens on a page of its own and a quick action in Salesforce's own window; both return to the grid. An autolaunched flow runs on the server for each record, 50 records per call.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A screen flow opens on a page of its own and a quick action in Salesforce's window. An autolaunched flow runs on the server for each record. To run Apex, call it from an autolaunched flow.
